reason: A long-term memory plugin that extracts and consolidates session knowledge, injects a summary into new sessions, and provides on-demand memory management tools.

summaries.zh: 用于提取、整理并注入长期记忆的插件，支持按需列出、读取、搜索和添加记忆。
summaries.en: A long-term memory plugin that extracts and consolidates session knowledge, injects summaries into new sessions, and provides tools to manage memories on demand.

capabilities: reads session logs for per-session memory extraction
uses a model to extract and consolidate durable memories
writes and archives memory files under a configured memory root
injects a memory summary into new session prompts
provides tools to list, read, search, and explicitly add memories
